In my opinion, you need at least a week of effort for this application, and you should work at it every day. Draft that 250 words and take it seriously by consulting other people and taking their feedback. I put 3 jot notes per extracurricular in the boxes. Prepare for the interview by getting comfortable with speaking in front of a camera with their sample questions in the practice module. Good luck, YOU GOT THIS!!

Yes—a supplementary evaluation. It involved a questionnaire with 4 questions, and then an interview that could be done either online or in person. I did it online, via video upload, which... was honestly very poorly done.
This was my online video interview. https://www.loom.com/share/890335fec0214b0389ed3b678570ccc7; I had a lot of experience from directing shows as a part of my drama club, and was involved a lot with NTS. For the questionnaire they asked for a detailed recount of a live performance I had recently seen, and I talked about the details of a live performance I had stage tickets for, which allowed me to closely see the operations and relate to professional performers.
Got a $3500 scholarship. Am an IB student taking HL english, business, biology and SL chemistry, french and math aa.; I applied as a part of York's Concurrent BEd program (program code: YQ), which evaluates your submission after you are first accepted into a partnering department at the university. Got this offer, and am still waiting on the ConEd program. This means tjat technically on OUAC, this offer has been listed as an "Alternate Offer" as it stands whether or not I get into the BEd program. However, when initially applying on OUAC, I only needed to put the YQ program with my subject of major interest.
